profile.name: Ella
profile.title: Front End Developer
profile.bio:
I am a web developer with a love for building front-end interactive experiences and games.
 I enjoy experimenting with new technologies.

 In my free time I love tinkering with electronics, 3D printing, maintaining my homelab or playing VR Games.

skills.name: JavaScript
skills.context: Working knowledge and experience with modern JavaScript

skills.name: TypeScript
skills.context: Working knowledge and experience with TypeScript

skills.name: HTML
skills.context: All the latest HTML5 features and best practices

skills.name: CSS
skills.context: CSS has no secrets for me, and I have experience with various preprocessors although I tend to prefer vanilla CSS these days. I love challenging myself with complex animations and layouts without relying on javascript.

skills.name: Git
skills.context: I have experience with Git version control, and I am comfortable in the command line. I am familiar with Github, bitbucket, gitea and Azure DevOps.

skills.name: Vue
skills.context: I have made multiple projects using Vue 3 using the Composition API, with Pinia for state management.

skills.name: Three.js
skills.context: I love using Three.js to create interactivity on websites, from simple animations to full-fledged 3D worlds.

skills.name: Vite
skills.context: Working knowledge and experience with Vite

skills.name: PHP
skills.context: I have made multiple projects for clients using the latest PHP versions.

skills.name: MySQL
skills.context: I usually use MySQL for my projects, but am also familiar with other databases such as Postgres and SQLite.

skills.name: Laravel
skills.context: Whenever I need to build a backend for a project, I usually reach for Laravel in combination with Filament for quick and easy development.

skills.name: Unity
skills.context: I have supported multiple clients with their unity projects, and making integrations between Unity and the web.

skills.name: Electronics
skills.context: In my free time I love tinkering with electronics, or attempting to repair my broken devices.

skills.name: 3D Printing
skills.context: I have extensive experience with 3D printing, including designing and printing my own models.

skills.name: Homelab
skills.context: I have a homelab at home, running my own services and applications using a mix of Docker and Proxmox. I have a system tracking wherever my cat is around the house.

projects.name: Train Simulator
projects.description: A train simulator game built with Three.js, assisted by AI. The game allows you to drive a train, stop at stations and pick up passengers. (best played using a throttle and joystick controller)

projects.name: Ella.top
projects.description: My personal website, built with Vue 3 and Vite. You can try printing the website to get a version formatted as a CV.

projects.name: Ella.monster
projects.description: When I got the domain name ella.monster I wanted to do something silly, so I made a 3D monster that follows your pointer. It is a simple project built with Three.js. (in supported browsers the favicon matches the movement of the monster)

experience.description:
Building and shipping web applications. Creating interactive websites and experiences for various clients. 
 Consultancy for a number of Antwerp based agencies.

In my initial role at Elia, I was responsible for updating their matterport 3d scans, scanning new buildings and integrating interactive elements into the scans. Later on, I was part of the IoT team where I built interactive dashboards and websites for visualizing and controlling IoT devices.
